title: Detailed flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Pot body - terracotta -->
  <path d='M28 58 L72 58 L68 92 L32 92 Z' fill='#D97B4A'/>
  <!-- Pot bottom rim -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='40' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C46A3A'/>
  <!-- Pot top rim -->
  <rect x='24' y='54' width='52' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8945E'/>
  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='55' width='48' height='3' rx='2' fill='#F5A87A'/>
  <!-- Pot decoration band -->
  <rect x='30' y='70' width='40' height='4' rx='1' fill='#F5C469'/>
  <!-- Pot vertical lines -->
  <line x1='40' y1='58' x2='42' y2='88' stroke='#C46A3A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='58' x2='58' y2='88' stroke='#C46A3A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='20' ry='4' fill='#7A4E28'/>
  <!-- Soil texture dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='55' r='1' fill='#4A2E14'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='54' r='1' fill='#4A2E14'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='56' r='1' fill='#6A4020'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='55' r='0.8' fill='#4A2E14'/>
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q48 38 50 28 Q52 22 54 18' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Leaf left -->
  <path d='M49 42 Q38 36 34 40 Q36 46 48 44 Z' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <line x1='49' y1='42' x2='36' y2='41' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Leaf right -->
  <path d='M51 36 Q62 28 66 32 Q64 40 52 38 Z' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <line x1='51' y1='36' x2='63' y2='32' stroke='#4CAF50' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Leaf lower left -->
  <path d='M49 48 Q40 46 36 50 Q38 54 48 50 Z' fill='#81C784'/>
  <!-- Flower petals -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='16' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='18' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='27' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='21' r='5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <!-- Inner petals -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='16' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='18' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='21' r='3.5' fill='#FF8FA8'/>
  <!-- Flower center -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='4' fill='#FFD54F'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <!-- Small buds -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#FFD54F'/>
</svg>
